rules: No game data or runtime server code modified.
Only the logs named by the request were read for extraction.
Names are null when the allowed logs do not expose display names.
Quest/reward associations are only same-folder temporal associations and are marked uncertain unless same-timestamp.

limitations: enemy-state.csv/json do not include enemy display names; system-messages.log in the allowed set did not expose SimpleCharFullUpdate names, so names are unavailable here.
Damage amounts are captured as event type and health values; explicit amount is inferred only when currentHealth decreases between deduped observations.
Lifecycle-only entities may include ambient or non-hostile dynels because hostility is not explicit in the allowed logs.
